subject: Internal: Nimbus MAP orientation — roles, draft review, and kickoff prep
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Nimbus MAP orientation — roles, draft review, and kickoff prep

Team — attaching the initial MAP I sketched after yesterday's discovery. Goal is to get internal alignment before we send the formal kickoff doc to Nimbus and lock the kickoff time next week. High level: they want a 6–8 week evaluation window with clear acceptance criteria and an exec readout at the end.

Quick asks (please reply inline):
- Review the RACI sheet in tab "Owners" and confirm you can take the assigned items. I marked Laura as primary for demo/workflow acceptance, Karthik for infra/SE support, Marissa for adoption/CS plan, Monica as escalation/exec sponsorship.
- Check the proposed timeline (sheet: "Milestones") — I'm worried the procurement + security review might push us, see "Security blocking items".
- Read the attached Nimbus security questionnaire (nimbus-security-req.pdf) and flag anything we need documented in advance.

Proposed internal prep: 30-min sync Monday 10/05 10:00 AM PT to finalize the MAP and owner list, then send the customer version by EOD Monday. Can you all confirm availability? If not, suggest an alternate slot.

Attachments: NIM-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP draft), nimbus-security-req.pdf

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Note: when we send the customer-facing MAP we'll strip internal notes in the Owner column and add the evaluation setup steps for infra (SE checklist).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Nimbus MAP orientation — roles, draft review, and kickoff prep

Rafael — quick review below. I pulled the MAP into a short notes file (MAP_playbook_notes.txt) with suggested owner changes and SE checklist items. Main points: 

- RACI: Move "Network / VPN setup" from "Laura (A)" to "Monica (A)" and mark me as "R" for validation. Monica is already the escalation path and should gate approvals for network-level access.
- Timeline: Procurement + Security review realistically add 5 business days. Recommend we add a 1-week buffer before the first live-eval milestone.
- SE checklist: I added items for test dataset sizing, tokenization sanity checks, and KV-cache behavior for long-context prompts. We should include a "smoke test" step for inference latency measurements on the reserved instance.

I can take point on the SE checklist and be on the kickoff to run the infra sections. I'm available Mon 10/05 10:00 AM PT — that works for me.

Attachments referenced: MAP_playbook_notes.txt (brief), I'll add my inline comments to the shared Drive doc after our internal.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Thanks Rafael — I skimmed the MAP and the acceptance criteria look good overall. Two quick notes: 

1) Can we rename the milestone "Workflow sign-off" to "Feature acceptance (workflow)" so it's clearer for the customer?
2) I can own the demo and acceptance testing, but for procurement-related docs (SLA wording / contract redlines) we'll need legal loop-in. Rafael, can you add a short line in the customer version that procurement should expect our legal contact (cc to procurement@redwood.com)?

Also looping Marissa because she should start drafting the adoption success milestones that map to the customer KPIs we captured.

I can make myself available Mon 10/05 10:00 AM PT but if procurement pushes, we might have to shift.

-Laura

All — I updated the Owners tab in NIM-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx and added a short RACI summary below. I also attached a one-page security note that calls out the two items Nimbus flagged as must-haves.

RACI (summary):
- Accountable (A): Monica Patel (overall exec sponsor & procurement sign-off)
- Responsible (R): Rafael Mendes (deal lead & customer comms), Laura Bennett (feature acceptance & demo owner), Karthik Iyer (SE / infra validation), Marissa Cole (CS / adoption plan owner)
- Consulted (C): Legal / Security (as needed)
- Informed (I): Solutions leadership / Product (for rollout readiness)

Decisions made:
- Add 5 business days buffer for security + procurement.
- Karthik will run the infra smoke test during the kickoff; Laura will lead the demo acceptance.
- I'll own procurement scheduling and loop legal when we have a signed MAP + initial SOW ask.

Confirming we keep the internal prep slot Mon 10/05 10:00 AM PT — please accept the calendar invite (I sent it). Rafael, I'll take the lead on updating the customer-facing MAP and will publish a version to the Drive link in the thread.

Attachments: NIM-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (updated), nimbus-security-req.pdf (annotated)

Monica Patel
Manager, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
